subject: Compact Demo Circuit — co-sponsor & speaker slot coordination
messages:
From: Sarah Green <sarah@elara.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Compact Demo Circuit — regional run, co-sponsor ask

Hi Marcus,

Hope you're well — small intro: I'm Sarah, partnerships at Elara Labs. We're running a 3-city 'Compact Demo Circuit' in Q3 (SF, Austin, NYC) that showcases partner-integrated demos: short 20-minute co-demos followed by a 10-minute customer Q&A. Attendance is focused on developer and product managers from mid-market SaaS.

Would Redwood be interested in co-sponsoring the SF stop (Oct 6) and taking a 20-minute co-demo slot with one of our customers? We can offer a keynote mention, joint social promotion, and complementary lead lists for attendees who opt-in.

Attached is a one-pager and our logo pack — rough budget and audience breakdown included. If this sounds interesting, can we lock a time next week to sync logistics and assets?

Cheers,
Sarah Green
Head of Partnerships | Elara Labs
attachments: Compact_Demo_Circuit_OnePager.pdf, Elara_Logo_Pack.zip
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Green <sarah@elara.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact Demo Circuit — regional run, co-sponsor ask

Thanks Sarah — this looks promising. Looping in Neha (Partner Programs) and Ben (Field & Events) to scope sponsorship level and logistics.

High level from our side:
- We can commit to a co-demo slot in SF and a modest sponsorship credit for event ops.
- Speaker: I'll propose Priya (Solutions) or Marcus (me) depending on availability; we can confirm by end of next week.
- Lead sharing: we need the opt-in consent wording and what fields come through (email, company, title).

Neha/Ben — quick ask: can you review the one-pager and confirm what sponsorship tier maps to the deliverables Sarah outlines (mention, social, lead list)? Also cost/ops for a small booth (2 staff) and AV needs for a co-demo.

Marcus Lin
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact Demo Circuit — regional run, co-sponsor ask

On Sun, Jul 11, 2027 at 10:15 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Sarah — this looks promising. Looping in Neha (Partner Programs) and Ben (Field & Events) to scope sponsorship level and logistics.

Thanks Marcus — reviewing the one-pager now. A few quick clarifying Qs for Sarah (cc'd):
1) What are expected audience counts for SF and the typical lead quality (self-identified PM/Eng vs general marketing)?
2) Do you have a draft SLA on lead delivery timing and format? We prefer CSV + HubSpot import file with opt-in flag.
3) AV/tech: Is the co-demo split-screen remote + on-stage or local kit? We'll need a dry-run slot and p2p test.

Ben — if we commit to sponsor, I'll aim for the 'demo partner' tier. Can you ballpark costs for a 10'x10' tabletop booth, two flight/hotel nights for two staff, and AV technician for the demo?

Neha Kapoor
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Green <sarah@elara.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact Demo Circuit — regional run, co-sponsor ask

Thanks — quick read-through and estimates below.
- Booth (10'x10' tabletop with power): $2,200 (ex setup).
- Travel (2 people, economy + 2 nights hotel): ~$1,600 total.
- AV tech (dry-run + event day): $950.
- Promo boost for Redwood socials + email inclusion: no additional cost if included in sponsor package.

Sarah — we can provide a Redwood speaker (Priya N.) for the co-demo. Prefer the demo be run from our laptop; we'll bring dongles and do a 30-min dry-run the week before. Lead delivery: happy to accept CSV or HubSpot push (we use HS). Need opt-in checkbox language — can you share the exact wording?

Ben Carter
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
attachments: cost-estimates.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Green <sarah@elara.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact Demo Circuit — regional run, co-sponsor ask

Perfect — thanks all. Next steps: 
- Sarah: send opt-in wording and confirm the sponsor tier that includes lead lists + social. Also confirm deadline to commit for SF (we'd like to decide by July 23).
- Ben: I'll route a PO for the booth and travel once Sarah confirms the sponsor package and we get a HS deal record.
- Neha: please draft a short MOU (1 page) capturing deliverables, lead timing, cancellation terms, and speaker backup policy. I'll review.

I'll block a 30-minute sync next Wed (Jul 21) 10:00am PT — if that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Marcus Lin
